fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Handcrafted Ceramic Wall Hooks (Set of 2)
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a splash of tradition to your home décor with these beautifully handcrafted Rajasthani ceramic wall hooks. Featuring vibrant floral designs in blue, orange, and white, these hooks are mounted on sturdy wrought iron for durability. Perfect for hanging keys, clothes, bags, or accessories, they serve both utility and style. Each piece is handmade by skilled artisans, making it a unique addition to your living space or a thoughtful gift for loved ones.
